scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n emulatori,web "npm run emulators" "USE_EMULATORS=true npm run start -w @turni/web"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @turni/functions && npx firebase emulators:start --project demo-turni
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/regole/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:rules: npm run build -w @turni/functions && npx firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-turni "vitest run --config tests/regole/vitest.config.ts"
